items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('My name is Monk Rowe') and James Lincoln Collier as the interviewee. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: He was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m really pleased to have James Lincoln Collier with me today, author, trombonist and Hamilton class of 1950.
